title: Fallen Werewolf Witch
description: A pale female character with long white braided hair lies fallen on broken stone pavement, wearing purple fishnet stockings and dark wings. She reaches toward a glowing blue orb containing a white paw print that emits bright light rays, surrounded by floating paw prints, chains, a blood moon, dark forest, and a stone path.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene of a pale witch with long white braid lying fallen backwards on cracked stone path, wearing purple fishnets and bat-like wings, one arm reaching up toward a bright glowing blue magical orb with a white wolf paw print inside that radiates light beams, scattered black paw prints floating in air, broken chains, dark twisted forest with bare trees, giant cracked red blood moon dominating the sky, gothic cemetery gates in background, high contrast comic book style with vibrant purple and blue accents
